requiredCapabilityAudit: All mandatory literal core service lookups checked on real default Host; scheduler and controller required at startup; sessionTitle/fs/sandboxPolicy also asserted.

optionalCapabilityAudit.nativeJobRecovery: Optional trusted process-isolation proof authority; absence refuses unsupported recovery rather than fabricating evidence.

validationBoundary: Isolated Linux, real Pi and local HTTP model protocol, native file/PTY/FFI/kernel paths; channel/business providers and Windows/macOS separate. No production deployment, migration, merge or CI.
